The clips each cast file carries once `/usr/bin/python3 examples/neon-dreams/blender/nd_poses.py` has made assets/aliens/<cast>-nd.glb (gitignored, never committed): the pack's 26 (`stock`), mirrored copies of its standing clips (`mirrored_stock`, *_m) and the authored ND_* clips (`authored`; kicks of 0.70 s = 2 beats at 171.4 BPM, so a rate of 1 sits on the grid; clip second 0 is ON a kick).

ND_Clap.about: claps at its chest on every kick, knees dipping, head nodding

ND_Clap_b.about: a big slow clap on every second kick, arms flung wide between, leaning back, rocking

ND_Arms_up.about: both arms up in a V, pumping on the kick; bounces from the knees

ND_Fist_pump.about: one fist punching the air on every kick, body turned a quarter, the other arm low

ND_Wave.about: arms high, swaying side to side like a lighter wave

ND_Sway.about: a two-step: weight from foot to foot on the kick, elbows bent, shoulders rolling

ND_Nod.about: arms folded, weight on one leg, nodding on the kick, a toe tapping

ND_Jump.about: a bounce: a small hop between kicks, landing on each one, its arms up and loose

ND_Groove.about: knees bouncing, fists pumping in turn at its chest, shoulders twisting

ND_Twist.about: the twist: hips one way, shoulders the other, down low and up again over four kicks

ND_Headbang.about: a wide stance, fists low, bowing from the waist on every kick: a full bow, then a lighter one; smooth

ND_Rock.about: rocks out: one fist held high and pulsing on the kick, the head nodding with it, the other fist low

ND_Point.about: points at the stage, jabbing on the kick, then turns to the one beside it and back; a hand on its hip

ND_Film.about: holds both hands up before its face (filming the stage), steadying, peeking round them

ND_Cheer.about: a cheer: both fists up, punching the air in turn, rising on its toes between kicks

ND_Stand.about: upright and easy: weight on one leg, arms loose, a slow look round, then the weight to the other leg

ND_Talk_a.about: talking: its hands open and close the points it makes, head tilting, weight shifting

ND_Talk_b.about: listening: a hand on its hip, nodding now and then, laughing back once

ND_Watch.about: arms folded, weight on one leg, looking slowly from one side to the other

ND_Hips.about: hands on its hips, feet apart, looking round and up, rocking on its heels

ND_Look_up.about: head back, a hand shading its eyes, following something across the sky

ND_Stretch.about: a long stretch: arms up and back, on its toes, then down, and a look round

ND_Hello.about: waves a raised hand at whoever is passing, the other on its hip, rising on its toes

ND_Lean.about: leaning on a rail (its forearms 1.0 m up, 0.35 m ahead of its spot), a knee slack; looks along the water

ND_Sit.about: sitting on the ground, knees up, hands on them, rocking a little, looking about

ND_Squat.about: squatting on its heels, forearms on its knees, poking at something on the ground now and then
ND_Squat.use: gardeners, fishers, kids at the front

ND_Fish.about: fishing: both hands hold a line out ahead, a slow lift, two tugs, a look down at the water
